mapper.select: SELECT b.tenant_id,b.project_id,b.evaluation_id,d.definition_json,b.content_sha256,v.content_sha256 AS registry_hash, JSON_OBJECT('dataset_version',b.dataset_version,'sample_manifest',b.sample_manifest,'sample_manifest_artifact_id',b.sample_manifest_artifact_id, 'rule_revision',b.rule_revision,'release_candidates',b.release_candidates,'authorized_use',b.authorized_use, 'split_manifest',b.split_manifest,'variance_policy',b.variance_policy,'missing_requirements',b.missing_requirements) AS projection, b.status,b.revision,r.result_json,r.result_sha256,b.schema_version,b.schema_manifest_sha256,b.created_by,b.created_at,b.classification FROM evaluation_batch b JOIN evaluation_definition d ON d.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND d.evaluation_id=b.evaluation_id AND d.content_sha256=b.content_sha256 AND d.schema_version=b.schema_version AND d.schema_manifest_sha256=b.schema_manifest_sha256 AND d.created_by=b.created_by AND d.created_at=b.created_at AND d.classification=b.classification JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND v.version_id=b.evaluation_id AND v.entity_kind='EVALUATION' AND v.owner_project_id <=> b.project_id LEFT JOIN evaluation_result r ON r.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND r.evaluation_id=b.evaluation_id AND r.definition_sha256=b.content_sha256 AND r.resulting_revision=b.revision AND r.production_eligible=0 AND r.schema_version=b.schema_version AND r.schema_manifest_sha256=b.schema_manifest_sha256 AND r.classification=b.classification WHERE b.evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.tenant_id,a.project_id,a.agent_version_id,a.content_sha256,v.content_sha256 AS registry_hash,a.agent_id,a.created_by, a.dependency_manifest,a.limits,a.status,a.schema_version,a.schema_manifest_sha256 FROM agent_version a JOIN version_registry v ON v.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND v.version_id=a.agent_version_id AND v.entity_kind='AGENT_VERSION' AND v.owner_project_id <=> a.project_id WHERE a.agent_version_id=#{candidateId} AND a.configuration_kind='AGENT' FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.capability_version AS version_id,c.kind,c.status,h.status AS head_status,NULL AS execution_mode FROM capability_version c JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND h.config_id=c.config_id AND h.kind=c.configuration_kind AND h.project_id <=> c.project_id WHERE c.capability_version IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT m.model_config_revision AS version_id,'MODEL' AS kind,m.status,h.status AS head_status,m.execution_mode FROM model_config_revision m JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND h.config_id=m.config_id AND h.kind=m.configuration_kind AND h.project_id <=> m.project_id AND h.execution_mode=m.execution_mode WHERE m.model_config_revision IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT a.agent_version_id AS version_id,'AGENT' AS kind,a.status,h.status AS head_status,NULL AS execution_mode FROM agent_version a JOIN configuration_head h ON h.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND h.config_id=a.agent_id AND h.kind=a.configuration_kind AND h.project_id <=> a.project_id WHERE a.agent_version_id IN #{id}
SELECT prompt_revision FROM context_manifest c WHERE context_manifest_id=#{contextId} AND execution_mode='SIMULATION' AND project_id <=> #{projectId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.score_id,s.evaluation_id,o.score_json,o.content_sha256,s.schema_version,s.schema_manifest_sha256,s.created_by,s.created_at,s.classification, JSON_OBJECT('sample_id',s.sample_id,'agent_version_id',s.agent_version_id,'dimension',s.dimension,'value',CAST(s.value AS CHAR), 'value_text',s.value_text,'numerator',s.numerator,'denominator',s.denominator,'rule_revision',s.rule_revision,'input_ref',s.input_ref, 'output_ref',s.output_ref,'evidence_ref',s.evidence_ref,'scorer_id',s.scorer_id,'supersedes',s.supersedes,'status',s.status, 'repeat_index',o.repeat_index,'expected_revision',CAST(o.expected_revision AS CHAR),'definition_sha256',o.definition_sha256) AS projection FROM evaluation_score s LEFT JOIN evaluation_score_observation o ON o.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND o.score_id=s.score_id AND o.evaluation_id=s.evaluation_id AND o.sample_id=s.sample_id AND o.agent_version_id=s.agent_version_id AND o.dimension=s.dimension AND o.supersedes <=> s.supersedes AND o.schema_version=s.schema_version AND o.schema_manifest_sha256=s.schema_manifest_sha256 AND o.created_by=s.created_by AND o.created_at=s.created_at AND o.classification=s.classification WHERE s.evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} ORDER BY o.expected_revision LIMIT 50001
SELECT upstream_version_id FROM lineage_edge e WHERE consumer_version_id=#{evaluationId} AND relation_kind='EVALUATION_DEFINITION' ORDER BY upstream_version_id
mapper.update: UPDATE evaluation_batch SET status=#{nextStatus},revision=revision+1,missing_requirements=#{missing},updated_at=#{now} WHERE evaluation_id=#{evaluationId} AND content_sha256=#{definitionHash} AND revision=#{expected} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name=#{operationName} AND idempotency_key=#{key}

SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE aggregate_id=#{evaluationId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resulting} AND event_type=#{eventType} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.operation_id'))=#{operationId}
